item.title: 科研论文每日速递 | 2026-09-02 | 10 篇
item.description:
本期收录 10 篇论文。

  1. HiRS-Agent: A Hierarchical Multi-Agent System for Reliable Long-Horizon Remote Sensing Task Solving — HiRS-Agent：用于可靠长时序遥感任务求解的分层多智能体系统 (100/100)
  2. A Composition-Aware Pretraining Framework for Geospatial Foundation Models — 地理空间基础模型的组成感知预训练框架 (95/100)
  3. GeoRisk-RAG: A Hierarchy-Aware Risk Framework for Improving RAG Reliability through Selective Answering — GeoRisk-RAG：一种层级感知的风险框架，通过选择性回答提高RAG可靠性 (95/100)
  4. Parameter-efficient multimodal adaptation of vision foundation models for remote sensing semantic segmentation — 遥感语义分割中视觉基础模型的参数高效多模态适配 (95/100)
  5. SERA-H: Super-Resolution of Sentinel Time Series for Fine-Scale Canopy Height Mapping — SERA-H：用于精细冠层高度制图的Sentinel时间序列超分辨率 (95/100)
  6. Spatial-Frequency Gated Swin Transformer for Cross-Sensor Remote Sensing Super-Resolution — 用于跨传感器遥感超分辨率的空间-频率门控Swin Transformer (95/100)
  7. Combining knowledge-based training data generation and deep learning algorithms for mapping surface water bodies, wetlands, and paddy rice in Northeast Asia — 结合基于知识的训练数据生成和深度学习算法绘制东北亚地表水体、湿地和水稻 (90/100)
  8. GridFlow: Structured Latent Flow for Seamless City-Scale 3D Point Cloud Generation — GridFlow：用于无缝城市尺度3D点云生成的结构化潜流 (90/100)
  9. SAGE-XGBoost: Spatially Augmented Graph Embeddings--Machine Learning Framework for Natural Hazards Susceptibility Mapping under Data Scarcity — SAGE-XGBoost：用于数据稀缺条件下自然灾害易发性制图的空间增强图嵌入机器学习框架 (90/100)
  10. Physics-informed regression-residual reconstruction and group fusion dual-attention transformer for methane plume detection — 物理信息回归残差重建与组融合双注意力Transformer用于甲烷羽流检测 (85/100)

item.title: 科研论文每日速递 | 2026-09-01 | 10 篇
item.description:
本期收录 10 篇论文。

  1. Securing Multi-Agent GIS Systems: Risk Evaluation and Prompt Hardening Optimization — 保护多智能体GIS系统：风险评估与提示词加固优化 (90/100)
  2. FORMSpoT: Revealing Fine-Scale Forest Disturbances from Nation-Wide 1.5 m Forest Canopy Height Time Series — FORMSpoT：从全国1.5米分辨率森林冠层高度时间序列中揭示精细尺度森林扰动 (95/100)
  3. Bootstrapping a 4D LiDAR Annotation Tool from Video Foundation Models — 从视频基础模型引导4D LiDAR标注工具 (70/100)
  4. Effectiveness of IoT and Deep Learning for Detection and Severity Assessment of Postelectrotermes militaris in Tea Plantations — 物联网与深度学习在茶园Postelectrotermes militaris检测与严重程度评估中的有效性 (65/100)
  5. Tatarstan Toponyms: A Bilingual Dataset and Hybrid RAG System for Geospatial Question Answering — 鞑靼斯坦地名：用于地理空间问答的双语数据集与混合RAG系统 (85/100)
  6. Stack Transformer Based Spatial-Temporal Attention Model for Dynamic Sign Language and Fingerspelling Recognition — 基于堆叠Transformer的时空注意力模型用于动态手语和指拼识别 (40/100)
  7. AcrossVAM1.0: Particle World Modeling for Text-Assisted Robot Video Prediction — AcrossVAM1.0：用于文本辅助机器人视频预测的粒子世界建模 (55/100)
  8. CASTANET: Causality-Aware Spatio-Temporal Adversarial Network Using Traffic Incident Effects — CASTANET：利用交通事故影响的因果感知时空对抗网络 (88/100)
  9. Planetary Prediction Engine: Autonomous Geospatial Prediction via Intelligent Data Selection and Foundation Model Embeddings — 行星预测引擎：通过智能数据选择和基础模型嵌入实现自主地理空间预测 (92/100)
  10. Tropospheric temperature and humidity profile retrieval from Meteosat Flexible Combined Imager based on deep learning — 基于深度学习从Meteosat灵活组合成像仪反演对流层温度和湿度廓线 (75/100)
